A.chapter_flow: Unit ke scale-based overview se Calvin ki kahani aur photosynthesis ke mahatva tak; phir experiments, chloroplast ka ek baar poora spatial tour, pigments, light reactions, electron aur proton flow, carbon fixation, C₄ specialisation, photorespiration aur environmental limits. Har numbered heading alag course chapter rahega. Concrete worked examples har film mein hain. Table aur exercise ke conflicting hints ke bajay supplied figure ke actual labels follow honge.

films.title: Ek plant, samajhne ke kai levels
films.question: Plant physiology ko molecules aur poore plant se saath kaise samjhein?
films.prerequisite: Cells, cell walls, molecules aur organism ka basic meaning.
films.opens_with: Scene: garden ke ek flowering plant par nazar, phir unit-page ke do curved cells aur beech ka pore.
story: Illustration mein guard cells aur stomatal pore pehchano; gas exchange aur water loss ka sambandh batao.
Worked example: isi garden plant ko surroundings, whole organism, cells aur molecules ke levels par dekho; ecology aur physiology competing explanations nahi hain.
Unit 4 ka scope kholo: Photosynthesis in Higher Plants, Respiration in Plants, aur Plant Growth and Development; molecular processes ko cellular, organismic aur environmental context mein padhenge.
Yahan sirf levels ka overview hai; leaf-to-chloroplast ka detailed journey abhi nahi.

analogy.picture: Ek map ke alag zoom levels.
analogy.why_it_fits: Scale badalta hai, plant wahi rehta hai; explanations ek doosre ko complement karte hain.

examples: Ek garden flowering plant ko environment, whole organism, cells aur molecules ke levels par compare karo; unit illustration ke guard cells aur pore ko function se jodo.
real_world: Garden plants mein gas exchange aur water loss ek hi stomatal opening se linked hain.

saman.shows: Unit-page botanical illustration: paired curved cells aur central pore, identifiable overlays ke saath.
saman.why: Structure se gas-exchange function connect hota hai.

saman.shows: Garden plant ke environmental, organismic, cellular aur molecular views; unit ke teen chapter names.
saman.why: Unit overview ko scales aur processes ke saath organise karta hai.

films.title: Calvin ne invisible carbon ka raasta kaise dekha?
films.question: Radioactive carbon se plant ke reactions kaise trace hue?
films.prerequisite: Atoms, isotopes aur chemical reactions ka brief bridge.
films.opens_with: Historical puzzle: World War II ke baad radio-activity ko beneficial research tool kaise banaya gaya?
story: Portrait ke saath Calvin ki short story: Minnesota, April 1911; Chemistry Ph.D., University of Minnesota; Professor at Berkeley.
Calvin aur J.A. Bassham ne C¹⁴-labelled CO₂ se green plants mein carbon assimilation investigate ki.
Worked example: ek labelled carbon atom ko supplied CO₂ se organic products mein follow karo; label marker hai, energy source nahi.
Organised pigment arrays aur electron transfer wale proposal ko carbon-pathway mapping se alag contribution rakho; abhi detailed mechanism nahi.
1961 Nobel Prize ko carbon-assimilation mapping se jodo; renewable resources aur solar-energy research tak relevance dikhao.

analogy.picture: Parcel par tracking tag.
analogy.why_it_fits: Detectable identity se route milta hai; tag parcel ko chalane ki energy nahi deta.

examples: Calvin–Bassham investigation mein supplied C¹⁴-labelled CO₂ ke ek carbon atom ko green plant ke organic products tak trace karo.
real_world: Photosynthesis ke principles renewable energy, materials aur solar-energy research mein kaam aate hain.

outside_book.what: Isotopes ka short atomic explanation.
outside_book.why: Radioactive label aur ordinary carbon ka relationship samajhne ke liye.

saman.shows: Calvin portrait aur Minnesota–Berkeley biography timeline, Nobel 1961 ke saath.
saman.why: Scientist, historical context aur contribution ko identify karta hai.

saman.shows: C¹⁴-labelled CO₂ se products tak tracer arrows; separate pigment-electron proposal aur research applications.
saman.why: Carbon tracing aur energy conversion ko mix kiye bina dono contributions dikhata hai.

films.title: Humare food ki shuruaat kahan hoti hai?
films.question: Plants food banate hain toh hum un par kaise depend karte hain?
films.prerequisite: Food provides matter and energy; consumers obtain food by feeding.
films.opens_with: Question: tumhari plate ka food peeche trace karein toh uski shuruaat kahan milegi?
story: Worked example: green plant → grazing animal → human food dependence trace karo.
Autotroph organic food synthesise karta hai; mineral absorption ko food synthesis mat samjho.
Photosynthesis ki physico-chemical definition kholo: light energy organic-compound synthesis drive karti hai; carbon aur energy inputs alag hain.
Food production aur atmospheric oxygen release, dono importance batao; sunlight-dependence ko chapter ke ecological context mein rakho, universal exceptionless claim nahi.
Oxygen na ho toh kya hoga pose karke answer do: aerobic cellular energy supply severely affected hogi.
Apne words mein roadmap do: machinery aur energy-converting reactions padhenge; abhi organelle tour nahi.

analogy.picture: Food-dependence tree ki roots.
analogy.why_it_fits: Alag consumer branches ka organic-food supply ek productive base se judta hai.

examples: Green plant → grazing animal → human food chain mein organic food ka source aur consumers ki dependence step by step trace karo.
real_world: Plant-derived food human diets aur livestock feeding ko support karta hai.

outside_book.what: Autotrophic bacteria aur sunlight-independent chemosynthetic ecosystems ke brief exceptions.
outside_book.why: Printed plant-only autotrophy aur all-life sunlight statements ko absolute misconception banne se rokna.

saman.shows: Plant, grazing animal aur human food-chain scene; plant se food aur O₂ ke separate outputs.
saman.why: Food dependence, energy conversion aur oxygen importance ko ek context deta hai.

films.title: Leaf ke starch test se requirements kaise prove hoti hain?
films.question: Chlorophyll, light aur CO₂ zaroori hain, yeh evidence se kaise bolenge?
films.prerequisite: Controlled comparisons; iodine starch test ka short demonstration.
films.opens_with: Experiment: ek variegated leaf aur ek black-paper-covered leaf ko light mein rakho—starch kahan milega?
story: Green versus non-green regions chlorophyll ko, covered versus uncovered regions light ko test karte hain.
Worked example: matched leaf maps par starch-positive regions mark karo; purana starch hataane ke liye destarching ka reason batao.
KOH-soaked cotton wala test-tube setup dekho: enclosed leaf portion se CO₂ remove hota hai, outside portion ko air milti hai.
Conclusion wala in-text question pose aur answer karo: comparable illuminated portions mein CO₂-deprived region negative aur exposed region positive hona CO₂ requirement support karta hai.
Starch indirect evidence hai; requirements ki recalled list water ko unnecessary nahi banati.

analogy.picture: Ek hi setting mein ek switch badalna.
analogy.why_it_fits: Inference tab strong hota hai jab relevant difference sirf tested condition ho.

examples: Variegated leaf aur partly black-paper-covered leaf ke starch maps compare karo; phir ek leaf ke KOH-enclosed aur air-exposed portions se CO₂ requirement infer karo.

outside_book.what: Destarching, iodine-test interpretation aur KOH ko learner se handle na karwana.
outside_book.why: Old starch confounding aur chemical-safety risk se bachna; teacher-supervised demonstration banana.

saman.shows: Variegated aur partly covered leaf ke before/after starch maps.
saman.why: Chlorophyll test aur light test ke variables alag karta hai.

saman.shows: KOH cotton test tube mein enclosed leaf portion aur outside control; iodine outcomes.
saman.why: Gas removal se experimental conclusion tak causal chain visible hoti hai.

films.title: Plants air ko kab restore karte hain?
films.question: Priestley aur Ingenhousz ke experiments ne alag-alag kya dikhaya?
films.prerequisite: Burning aur animal respiration oxygen consume karte hain; closed jars freely air exchange nahi karte.
films.opens_with: Scene: band bell jar mein candle bujh gayi—mint plant add karne se result kyun badal sakta hai?
story: History ko questions ki sequence banao: Priestley 1770 bell jars; oxygen discovery 1774 alag milestone.
Worked example: Figure 11.1 ke a→b aur c→d horizontal pairs compare karo, a→b→c→d sequence nahi.
Mint experiment se restoration-of-air hypothesis nikalo; modern oxygen interpretation ko historical wording se distinguish karo.
Jar khole bina rekindling question answer karo: teacher-controlled lens se sunlight focus karna ya sealed electrical ignition possible designs hain; live-animal replication nahi.
Ingenhousz ke dark/sunlight comparison se sunlight requirement aur unnamed aquatic plant ke green parts par oxygen bubbles se tissue restriction samjhao.
Plants ko passive air filters mat bolo; respiration aur illuminated photosynthesis ke net effects distinguish karo.

analogy.picture: Shared oxygen account mein withdrawals aur replenishment.
analogy.why_it_fits: Burning aur respiration oxygen ghataate hain, illuminated photosynthesis replenish kar sakti hai.

examples: Priestley ke mint plant, mouse aur candle wale bell jars ke do separate before–after pairs se air-restoration hypothesis nikalo; Ingenhousz ka light–dark control usmein kya add karta hai, batao.
real_world: Sunlit aquatic vegetation ke paas oxygen bubbles observe kiye ja sakte hain.

outside_book.what: Sealed electrical ignition ya lens-focussed sunlight as possible rekindling designs; simulations instead of animal experiments.
outside_book.why: In-text design question ka answer aur safe, ethical classroom treatment.

saman.shows: Figure 11.1 ke four panels, sirf do horizontal arrows aur mint-plant comparison.
saman.why: Conditions, outcomes aur undisturbed testing ka logic clear hota hai.

saman.shows: Same aquatic-plant setup light aur dark mein, green tissues ke bubbles highlighted.
saman.why: Ingenhousz ke additional controls aur conclusion alag dikhte hain.

films.title: Sugar aur effective light ka evidence
films.question: Sachs aur Engelmann ne food formation aur useful colours kaise pehchane?
films.prerequisite: Prism, visible colours aur aerobic respiration ka brief bridge.
films.opens_with: Puzzle: microscopic bacteria light ke useful colours ke detectors kaise ban sakte hain?
story: Sachs, about 1854: glucose production, green parts, chlorophyll-containing chloroplasts aur starch storage ko findings ki chain banao; detailed structural zoom reserve rakho.
Worked example: prism-separated light se Cladophora illuminate karo; aerobic bacteria blue aur red regions mein accumulate hote hain.
Bacteria oxygen detect karte hain, photosynthesis alga karti hai; output-based action spectrum ka meaning kholo.
Mid-nineteenth-century synthesis do: light se CO₂ aur water se carbohydrates bante hain; next film equation accounting karegi.

analogy.picture: Oxygen-rich spots ki taraf jama hote living reporters.
analogy.why_it_fits: Bacterial location invisible O₂ evolution ka spatial signal deti hai.

examples: Engelmann ke Cladophora experiment mein prism-separated colours lagao aur blue/red bacterial clusters se greater O₂ evolution aur action spectrum infer karo.

outside_book.what: Prism aur wavelength-colour relationship ka prerequisite sketch.
outside_book.why: Engelmann ke experiment mein independent variable identify karna.

saman.shows: Cladophora, prism spectrum aur blue/red bacterial clusters; side strip mein Sachs glucose-to-starch findings.
saman.why: Historical evidence ko measured outputs se connect karta hai, organelle tour repeat nahi karta.

films.title: Released oxygen water se kyun aati hai?
films.question: Photosynthesis equation mein 12 water kyun hain, aur O₂ ka source kya hai?
films.prerequisite: Coefficients versus subscripts, atom balance, oxidation–reduction aur isotope markers.
films.opens_with: Number puzzle: equation ke left par 12H₂O, right par 6H₂O—net water kitna gaya?
story: Empirical equation mein [CH₂O] composition unit hai; glucose ka actual formula C₆H₁₂O₆ hai.
Van Niel ke purple/green bacterial studies se general donor equation 2H₂A + CO₂ → 2A + CH₂O + H₂O explain karo.
Worked example: H₂O donor ko H₂S se replace karke oxidation products compare karo: plant O₂ versus bacterial sulphur/sulphate, organism ke according.
Inference aur proof alag rakho: evolved O₂ water se aati hai; classic proof stable oxygen-18 isotopic tracing tha, radioactive oxygen tracing nahi.

Balanced plant equation ke atoms count karo; 12 gross input waters mein se 6 net consumed hain. Six O₂ formation ke electron accounting mein 12 waters oxidised hote hain, aur overall reduction accounting mein 6 waters reappear karte hain.
Twelve-water in-text question answer karo; water cancellation ko atom-source proof mat bolo. Overall arrow ko multistep process ka summary batao.

analogy.picture: Account mein total debit aur refund ke baad net debit.
analogy.why_it_fits: Input-side 12 aur net 6 alag accounting quantities hain.

examples: 6CO₂ + 12H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6H₂O + 6O₂ mein atoms count karke 12 gross aur 6 net waters distinguish karo; donor substitution mein H₂S ka oxidation product O₂ nahi hota.
real_world: H₂S-using photosynthetic bacteria dikhate hain ki har photosynthesis oxygen release nahi karti.

outside_book.what: Classic oxygen-source experiment mein stable ¹⁸O; water-oxidation aur CO₂-reduction half-reaction accounting.
outside_book.why: Printed radioisotope terminology correct karna aur 12 gross water versus 6 net water ka mechanistic accounting dena.

saman.shows: General H₂A equation ke plant H₂O aur bacterial H₂S substitutions.
saman.why: Variable donor aur changing oxidation products ko concrete banata hai.

saman.shows: ¹⁸O-water se released oxygen ka tracer path aur 6CO₂ + 12H₂O equation ka atom ledger.
saman.why: Atom origin, balance aur gross/net distinctions ko separate evidence ke saath dikhata hai.

films.title: Leaf se chloroplast: kaunsa kaam kahan?
films.question: Photosynthesis ki machinery plant mein exactly kahan hoti hai?
films.prerequisite: Leaf tissues, organelles, membrane versus fluid matrix; ATP energy aur NADPH reducing-power bridge.
films.opens_with: Visual journey: green plant se leaf, mesophyll cell aur ek chloroplast ke andar chalo.
story: Chapter ka ek hi detailed plant → leaf → mesophyll cell → chloroplast tour karo.
Other green parts wala question answer karo: green stems, sepals aur unripe green fruits possible photosynthetic sites hain.
Worked example: dim versus strong incident light mein beam aur wall draw karke chloroplast broad-face orientation reason karo; optimum ka matlab maximum nahi.
Figure 11.2 ke outer/inner membranes, grana, stromal lamellae, stroma, ribosomes, starch granule aur lipid droplet label karo.
Membranes light capture aur ATP/NADPH banati hain; stroma enzymatic sugar synthesis aur starch formation support karta hai.
Photochemical/light aur carbon/dark reactions distinguish karo; dark naam night-only process nahi.
Caption ko drawing ki identity se jodo: diagrammatic representation of an electron-micrograph section, natural-colour photograph nahi.

analogy.picture: Ek workplace ke specialised work-zones.
analogy.why_it_fits: Membrane aur stroma ke alag jobs hain, products unko functionally jodte hain.

examples: Ek mesophyll cell mein incident beam aur cell wall draw karke dim versus strong light mein chloroplast ki broad-face exposure compare karo; Figure 11.2 par working compartments locate karo.
real_world: Green stems aur unripe green fruits bhi photosynthesis kar sakte hain.

outside_book.what: Green stem, sepal aur green fruit examples; low-light broad-face exposure aur high-light avoidance orientation clarification; ATP/NADPH short bridge.
outside_book.why: In-text questions answer karna aur compartment functions ko meaningful banana.

saman.shows: Single continuous plant-to-chloroplast spatial journey aur green-organ alternatives.
saman.why: Chapter ka definitive spatial entry establish karta hai.

saman.shows: Wall, incident beam aur chloroplast flat surfaces ke dim/strong-light orientations.
saman.why: Parallel/perpendicular words ko actual reference directions deta hai.

saman.shows: Figure 11.2 ke sab eight labels; membrane aur stroma ke function overlays.
saman.why: Structure aur compartment-specific reactions ek reliable map par anchor hote hain.

films.title: Green leaf mein kitne pigments chhupe hain?
films.question: Ek green leaf ka colour ek pigment se aata hai ya mixture se?
films.prerequisite: Mixtures; visible light ke colours aur wavelength.
films.opens_with: Observation: same plant ke leaves mein green ke itne shades kyun dikhte hain?
story: Paper chromatography ko teacher demonstration banao: green extract separate bands deta hai.
Worked example: chlorophyll a bright/blue-green, b yellow-green, xanthophylls yellow aur carotenoids yellow-to-yellow-orange bands identify karo.
Pigment selected wavelengths absorb karta hai; visible green ka matlab strongest green absorption nahi.
Most abundant plant pigment question pose aur answer karo: chlorophyll a.
Practice bridge mein prolonged darkness se yellowing aur healthy shade acclimation alag phenomena batao.

analogy.picture: Ek chord ke andar alag musical notes.
analogy.why_it_fits: Combined appearance ke peeche several components hote hain, separation unko reveal karta hai.

examples: Green-leaf extract ke chromatogram mein bright/blue-green chlorophyll a, yellow-green b, yellow xanthophylls aur yellow-orange carotenoid bands ko colour se identify karo.
real_world: Prolonged darkness mein leaf ka yellow ya pale-green dikhna pigment balance se linked hai.

outside_book.what: Darkness mein chlorophyll decline, relatively persistent yellow pigments aur pigment masking; shade acclimation mein greater light-harvesting investment aur commonly lower a:b ratio.
outside_book.why: Exercises 6–7 ke liye evidence-based explanation; shade ko prolonged total darkness se distinguish karna.

outside_book.what: Chromatography solvent safety: teacher-controlled demonstration.
outside_book.why: Activity ko unsafe unsupervised chemical handling na banana.

saman.shows: Green extract ka four-colour chromatogram with named pigment bands, plus darkened/shaded leaf comparison.
saman.why: Mixture, band colours aur pigment persistence ko visible banata hai; exact migration order assume nahi karta.

films.title: Absorption aur action spectrum same kyun nahi?
films.question: Chlorophyll a chief hai toh baaki pigments kya karte hain?
films.prerequisite: Graph axes, peaks, wavelength scale aur different measured quantities.
films.opens_with: Graph puzzle: blue-red peaks match karte hain, par dono curves poori tarah overlap kyun nahi karte?
story: VIBGYOR recall ko apne words mein karo; wavelength horizontal axis aur absorbance vertical response padho.
Worked example: chlorophyll a ke approximately 420–430 aur 660–670 nm regions trace karo; b aur carotenoids ke shifted profiles identify karo.
In-text maximum/second-peak question ka answer blue aur red do; exact numerical readings approximate hain.
Action spectrum ka output O₂ release hai; high blue/red aur low-but-not-zero intermediate response dekho.
Chief pigment chlorophyll a conclude karo; complete one-to-one overlap question ka answer no.
Accessory pigments energy chlorophyll a ko transfer karke usable wavelengths badhate aur photo-oxidation se protect karte hain; energy transfer ko electron transfer mat bolo.
Superimposed graph ki unlike quantities ke numerical heights compare mat karo.

analogy.picture: Alag frequency ranges cover karne wale radio receivers.
analogy.why_it_fits: Different absorption ranges milkar available input ka wider range capture karte hain.

examples: Figure 11.3a mein chlorophyll a ke approximate 420–430 aur 660–670 nm peaks read karo; panel c mein intermediate wavelengths par unmatched action response se accessory-pigment contribution explain karo.

saman.shows: Figure 11.3a ke labelled chlorophyll a, b aur carotenoid curves with shared wavelength scale.
saman.why: Curve identity aur approximate peaks ko label se read karata hai, ink colour se nahi.

saman.shows: Figure 11.3b action curve aur 11.3c overlay, all axes/legends and unmatched regions.
saman.why: Absorption versus biological performance aur incomplete overlap explain karta hai.

saman.shows: Accessory pigments se chlorophyll a tak excitation-energy arrows aur protection overlay.
saman.why: Graph mismatch ko pigment functions se explain karta hai.

films.title: Photosystem mein antenna aur reaction centre
films.question: Captured light se electron transfer kaise shuru hota hai?
films.prerequisite: Pigment–protein complexes; photon aur excited electron ka short distinction.
films.opens_with: Molecular scene: ek photon peripheral pigment par hit karta hai—ab energy kahan jayegi?
story: Direct thylakoid machinery par start karo; light phase ke absorption, water splitting, O₂, ATP aur NADPH events list karo.
Hundreds of protein-bound antenna pigments aur special reaction-centre chlorophyll a distinguish karo.
Worked example: Figure 11.4 mein photon arrival → excitation-energy transfer → reaction centre → acceptor ko electron follow karo.
PS I aur PS II discovery order ke names hain, operational order nahi.
P700–PS I–700 nm aur P680–PS II–680 nm pair karo; dono reaction centres chlorophyll a hain.
Missing chlorophyll a centre ko excess chlorophyll b replace kyun nahi kar sakta, exercise ke liye reason karo.

analogy.picture: Collector dish se ek focal detector tak signal pahunchna.
analogy.why_it_fits: Broad collection aur photochemical initiation alag functions hain.

examples: Figure 11.4 mein ek peripheral pigment par photon arrival se excitation ko reaction-centre chlorophyll a tak aur phir electron ko primary acceptor tak follow karo.

outside_book.what: Excitation-energy transfer versus electron transfer/charge separation ka short distinction.
outside_book.why: Figure 11.4 aur missing-chlorophyll-a exercise ko accurately interpret karna.

saman.shows: Figure 11.4: photon, pigment molecules, reaction centre aur primary acceptor with distinct energy/electron arrows.
saman.why: Light harvesting se charge separation ka transition visible hota hai.

saman.shows: PS I/P700/700 nm versus PS II/P680/680 nm cards.
saman.why: Reaction-centre identity aur discovery-order trap ko cleanly distinguish karta hai.

films.title: Electron ko do light boosts kyun chahiye?
films.question: PS II se NADPH tak electron ka Z-shaped raasta kya hai?

story: P680 excitation se acceptor aur cytochrome-containing transport system tak flow trace karo.

P700 par second excitation aur second acceptor ke baad NADP⁺ reduction to NADPH trace karo.
Text ke NADPH + H⁺ notation ko recognise karo; oxidised acceptor NADP⁺ aur reduced carrier NADPH confuse na karo.
Figure 11.5 ke sab labels, ATP branch aur water-input shorthand locate karo; unke detailed mechanisms next headings ke liye reserve rakho.
Z shape redox-potential sequence ka representation hai, membrane ka actual zigzag shape nahi.

analogy.picture: Do powered lifts ke beech downhill sections.
analogy.why_it_fits: Light boosts aur carrier-mediated energy descent alternate karte hain.

examples: Figure 11.5 mein ek electron token ko P680 excitation, acceptor, cytochrome-containing ETS, P700 ki second excitation aur terminal NADP⁺ reduction tak trace karo.

outside_book.what: Electron-energy/redox representation ka sign-convention caveat.
outside_book.why: Schematic uphill/downhill ko physical movement ya contradictory redox ordering na samajhna.

saman.shows: Complete Figure 11.5 with both acceptors, light inputs, ETS, ATP branch, NADP⁺/NADPH aur water shorthand.
saman.why: Do excitations aur uninterrupted electron sequence ek frame mein visible hain.

films.title: PS II ke lost electrons kaun replace karta hai?
films.question: Water splitting se electrons, oxygen aur protons kahan milte hain?
films.prerequisite: H⁺, e⁻, atom/charge balance; lumen aur stroma ki local orientation.
films.opens_with: In-text sawaal: PS II electron bhejta rahe toh uski supply khatam kyun nahi hoti?
story: Answer do: PS II-associated water splitting replacement electrons deti hai; PS II transport chain se PS I ko replenish karta hai.
Worked example: 2H₂O ko 4H⁺ + O₂ + 4e⁻ mein balance karo; atoms aur charge count karo.
Local thylakoid cross-section mein water-splitting complex lumen-facing side par place karo.
Protons aur O₂ kahan release honge question pose aur answer karo: lumen side; O₂ baad mein diffuse kar sakti hai.
Water source ko ek sentence mein recall karo; historical proof dobara teach nahi.

analogy.picture: Chalti line ke starting slot mein naya token bharna.
analogy.why_it_fits: Continuous outward transfer ke liye donor se replenishment zaroori hai.

examples: Do water molecule models split karke 4H⁺, ek O₂ aur 4e⁻ count karo; electrons PS II ko aur protons lumen side ko route karo.
real_world: Green plants ka evolved atmospheric oxygen water oxidation se originate hota hai.

saman.shows: Lumen-facing PS II complex; two water molecules se counted products aur electron-replacement arrows.
saman.why: Stoichiometry aur release location ek local view mein establish karta hai.

films.title: Electron wapas aaye toh kya banta hai?
films.question: Cyclic aur non-cyclic photophosphorylation mein kya difference hai?
films.prerequisite: ADP + inorganic phosphate se ATP; chemical energy ko net reaction se samajhna.

Beyond 680 nm excitation condition preserve karo; 'possible location' ko exclusive location mat bana do.

analogy.picture: Round-trip ticket versus one-way ticket.
analogy.why_it_fits: Return destination route ko classify karti hai; products bhi accordingly differ karte hain.

examples: Figure 11.6 mein P700 ka electron acceptor aur ETS se wapas P700 par lao; loop ke ATP output aur absent NADP⁺ branch ko non-cyclic route se contrast karo.

outside_book.why: Printed bond-energy wording se chemistry misconception prevent karna.

saman.shows: Figure 11.6 ke seven labels aur P700 return loop; cyclic/non-cyclic product comparison.
saman.why: Electron return, ATP branch aur absent NADP⁺ branch ko visible karta hai.

saman.shows: Earlier complete Z scheme, sirf non-cyclic route reminder ke liye.
saman.why: Already-taught route ko briefly contrast karta hai.

films.title: Lumen mein H⁺ kyun jama hote hain?

Figure 11.7 ke all labels read karo: PSII, PQ/PQH₂, cytochrome B6f, PC, PSI, Fd, FNR; electron aur proton arrows alag trace karo.
Figure ke CF₀/CF₁ aur ATP arrows identify karo as next film ka destination; mechanism abhi reserve rakho.
Lumen high H⁺, stroma low H⁺ aur lumen pH decrease conclude karo; exact pH invent nahi.
NADP reduction proton consumption hai, translocation nahi.

analogy.picture: Dam ke peeche jama paani.
analogy.why_it_fits: Barrier ke across maintained difference energy store karta hai; controlled return useful work kara sakta hai.

saman.why: Three gradient-building causes ko correct sides aur carrier pathway ke saath map karta hai.

saman.shows: Lumen/stroma proton ledger aur qualitative pH arrow.
saman.why: Addition, transport aur consumption ka difference explicit karta hai.

films.title: H⁺ ke return se ATP kaise banta hai?
films.question: Gradient aur ATP synthase ke beech actual connection kya hai?

films.opens_with: In-text challenge: proton gradient mein itni interest kyun—sirf H⁺ jama karne se ATP ban jayega?
